text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 电影场景第2批 · 03 · 雪中石屋门廊.
Environment:  An original English stone cottage exterior after light snowfall on a bright overcast winter morning. Warm gray limestone, low slate roof with patchy snow, a small oak front door beneath a shallow cream-painted porch, climbing bare rose stems, simple terracotta pots without figures, a short curved stone path through untouched white snow. One window reveals cream curtains and a tiny warm lamp. Eye-level from gate, cottage offset right, layered quiet snowy hedges. Cozy believable village scale. No footprints shaped as creatures, no snowmen, no holiday figures.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent orthographic overhead CONCEPT PLAN. Depict footprint, connected zones, wall thickness, doors, windows, stairs, furniture footprints and circulation. For outdoors use a site plan of paths, terrain, bridges and water instead of domestic rooms. North is only design orientation. Compact labels; no invented metric dimensions. Flat diagram on white background.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Redraw this layout as a STRICT FLAT TWO DIMENSIONAL overhead floor/site plan, camera exactly vertical 90 degrees. CAD architectural floor plan, black linework and pale simple color fills on white. Zero perspective. Zero raised walls, vertical facades, furniture legs or visible window elevations. Existing spatial relationships unchanged: use horizontal footprints only, single large plan with clear labels and door arcs, no dimensions, no characters. Title CONCEPT PLAN. The reference is layout guide, not drawing style.
